world.title: ‘Ensure safety of Indian nationals’: MEA’s strong message to US after alleged Hindu temple attack plot
world.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) of India expressed concern regarding a foiled mass-shooting plot aimed at the Sri Venkateswara Swami Temple in Aurora, Illinois. The MEA urged the United States to ensure the safety of Indian nationals and emphasized the importance of protecting places of worship. The incident highlights ongoing security issues faced by religious communities abroad.

world.title: Katie Zacharia admits she failed the bar exam on her first attempt in 2011, years after calling herself a lawyer
world.summary: Katie Zacharia, the new White House press secretary, disclosed that she failed her bar exam on her first attempt in 2011 in California. She did not retake the exam after relocating to China. Despite previously referring to herself as a lawyer, Zacharia's admission highlights her lack of a valid law license, raising questions about her legal qualifications.

world.title: Pakistan to chair IMF, World Bank boards in 2027; first time in over 70 years
world.summary: Pakistan will chair the boards of governors of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Group in 2027, marking its first leadership role in over 70 years. This announcement was made during the plenary session of the 2026 World Bank Group-IMF annual meetings held in Bangkok. The decision highlights Pakistan's significant return to international financial governance.

business.title: Trump's Oil Price Strategy Faces Two Major Tests This Weekend
business.summary: Trump's energy strategy faces challenges this weekend due to two key decisions. He is refraining from military intervention in Saudi Arabia's conflict with the Houthis, potentially diminishing U.S. leverage. Additionally, easing sanctions on Russian diesel may offer limited relief from rising energy prices. These moves aim to lower pump prices ahead of the November 3 deadline.

business.title: IDBI Bank employees' terms and pensions protected post
business.summary: IDBI Bank employees will have their terms and pensions protected following the lender's strategic sale. DIPAM Secretary Arunis Chawla addressed concerns about the sale, emphasizing that the narrative of DIPAM failing to meet Budget targets has been countered by the IDBI deal. He acknowledged that achieving this outcome was challenging but ultimately successful for the employees' security.

business.title: No deals in the immediate future, says Federal Bank MD & CEO KVS Manian
business.summary: Federal Bank's MD and CEO KVS Manian stated that while the bank is assessing acquisition opportunities, no immediate deals are anticipated. The lender recently raised approximately $1.5 billion, equivalent to Rs 14,922 crore, through its foreign currency non-resident bank (FCNR-B) deposit scheme. The focus remains on strategic evaluations rather than immediate transactions.

technology.title: OPPO Find X10 Pro Max to be India's First Phone with Triple 200MP Sensors
technology.summary: OPPO has announced the upcoming launch of the OPPO Find X10 Pro Max in India, set for October 22, 2026. This smartphone will feature triple 200MP sensors, marking it as India's first device with such technology. The announcement was made alongside the introduction of other products, highlighting OPPO's commitment to innovation in the smartphone market.

technology.title: Reliance Digital’s Festival of Electronics: Up to Rs 20,000 exchange bonus, flat 50% off on second product and more sale offers
technology.summary: Reliance Digital's Festival of Electronics is currently offering various deals for customers looking to upgrade their electronics. Promotions include an exchange bonus of up to Rs 20,000, flat 50% off on a second product, and discounts on a range of items such as smartphones, laptops, televisions, air conditioners, washing machines, and audio products.

technology.title: Tecno Spark 50s 5G Launched With 6,500mAh Battery, Dimensity 6400 Chipset and Military
technology.summary: Tecno has launched the Spark 50S 5G in India, featuring a 6,500mAh battery, Dimensity 6400 chipset, and a 120Hz display. The smartphone includes a 50MP camera and military-grade durability. Priced at Rs 19,999 for the 6GB+128GB variant and Rs 22,999 for the 8GB+128GB version, sales will start on October 20 via Amazon in two color options.

sports.title: Scotland pacer Brad Wheal announces retirement from cricket
sports.summary: Scotland pacer Brad Wheal has announced his retirement from professional cricket at age 30, citing his inability to cope with the physical demands of fast bowling due to recurring injuries. He made his debut for Scotland in 2016 against Hong Kong and participated in four Men's T20 World Cups, including the upcoming 2026 edition.

sports.title: 'Shami Doesn't Need to Prove Himself'
sports.summary: Former chief selector M S K Prasad advocates for Mohammed Shami's inclusion in the upcoming New Zealand series and the 2027 ODI World Cup. He emphasizes Shami's experience and skill. Additionally, former bowling coach Bharat Arun supports this view, stating that Shami has already proven his capabilities and does not need to demonstrate his worth further to the team.

health.title: Meningitis in India: Closing the gap between first symptom and first dose
health.summary: Acute bacterial meningitis poses significant challenges for India's healthcare system, as the critical time between the onset of symptoms and treatment can lead to irreversible damage. Many patients do not receive timely care, often losing valuable hours before reaching a hospital. Meningitis causes inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord, necessitating prompt medical intervention.

health.title: Early-onset Alzheimer's disease looks very different to late-onset version: study
health.summary: A new study reveals that early-onset Alzheimer's disease, occurring before age 65, presents distinct symptoms and health issues compared to late-onset Alzheimer's. Individuals with early-onset Alzheimer's accumulate various health problems, particularly in the five years prior to diagnosis. Unlike late-onset patients, those with early-onset do not exhibit additional cardiovascular risks, highlighting significant differences between the two forms of the disease.

health.title: PM2.5 exposure linked to higher hospitalisation risk across major diseases
health.summary: Short-term exposure to PM2.5 fine particulate matter is linked to higher hospitalisation rates for various diseases, including cancer, mental disorders, and neurological issues. This finding is particularly concerning as the Delhi-NCR region approaches its winter pollution season, where air quality typically worsens. The study highlights the broader health impacts of air pollution beyond respiratory problems.

science.title: Scientists Discover Natural "Off Switch" for Nitrogen-Fixing Enzyme
science.summary: Researchers at Saint Louis University have identified a natural "off switch" for nitrogenase, the enzyme responsible for biological nitrogen fixation. This discovery reveals the three-dimensional structure of the enzyme, which has been poorly understood for decades. The findings could have significant implications for the future of nitrogen fertilizers, potentially leading to more sustainable agricultural practices.

science.title: Like Geological Sites in Tamil Nadu and Chile
science.summary: Indian researchers have discovered geological sites in Tamil Nadu and Chile’s Atacama Desert that exhibit mineralogical and environmental traits similar to Mars. This finding provides valuable insights into Mars' history of water activity and its potential for habitability. The University of Kerala team identified two hydrous sulphate minerals, melanterite and gypsum, at these significant locations.

science.title: Japan to launch spacecraft to Martian moon Phobos on Tuesday, bring back rocks in 2031
science.summary: Japan's space agency, JAXA, is set to launch its MMX spacecraft on Tuesday, targeting the Martian moon Phobos. This mission aims to collect samples from Phobos and return them to Earth by 2031. The samples may provide insights into the formation of Mars and its moons, marking a significant step in planetary exploration and research.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, October 17, 2026: A long-awaited breakthrough may change how you see your journey
entertainment.summary: On October 17, 2026, an unexpected breakthrough may provide a new perspective and enhance confidence, guiding individuals toward a clearer path. Effective communication and focused thinking are essential to leverage this momentum. Acceptance of unchangeable circumstances can aid in regaining perspective. This period may inspire nurturing relationships, developing ideas, or improving personal surroundings for overall growth.

entertainment.title: Nitanshi Goel’s Suneet Varma showstopper moment is a masterclass in modern Indian glamour
entertainment.summary: Nitanshi Goel, star of ‘Laapataa Ladies,’ made a significant entrance into high fashion as the showstopper for designer Suneet Varma at Lakmé Fashion Week. Her appearance showcased Varma’s unique couture alongside her own fresh style, highlighting a moment of modern Indian glamour. This event has positioned Goel prominently on the fashion radar, signaling her rising influence in the industry.

entertainment.title: Yami Gautam got a fat cheque for cameo in Aditya Dhar's 'Dhurandhar'? The actress clarifies, 'To get directed by one of the finest directors...'
entertainment.summary: Yami Gautam will appear on Madhuri Dixit’s quiz show ‘Kon Honar Crorepati’ to promote her upcoming film ‘Nayyi Navelli’. In a promo, she discusses her cameo in husband Aditya Dhar’s film ‘Dhurandhar’, emphasizing her excitement about being directed by a talented filmmaker. Gautam's participation highlights her ongoing promotional efforts for her latest project.
